author: nflaig
content: <@&1417820113981145228> when do clients "freeze" p2p bids right now? for builder api bids we have timeouts between 500-600ms (might wanna standardize that still) but it's not clear to me how clients pick the bid from the p2p pool but I think this should be standardized, otherwise it's impossible to know when you have to broadcast the bid on p2p which gives builders via api a significant advantage since they can return the bid as late as the proposer allows via the configured timeout

author: potuz
content: We give direct connection builders 600ms by default but it's configurable (and I plan to add a flag to request multiple times). We keep accepting P2P bids until the very last second and choose among all we have. So in principle someone could time to send their P2P bid to be in flight at the time that the request for direct connected builders is already sent
